title: 16barlogic — Adaptive Non-Linear Music System
subtitle: Unity / C# / FMOD / State Machine Logic
description:
An interactive audio demo designed in Unity to showcase adaptive music implementation. By utilizing vertical layering and horizontal resequencing techniques, the system dynamically shifts musical stems and themes in response to changing gameplay states.

Development Note: All audio design, DSP calculations, and acoustic logic in this project were developed entirely by me. Surrounding gameplay elements (player movement, combat triggers) were AI-assisted to quickly build an interactive testbed for the audio systems — the focus here is the sound architecture. For a from-scratch implementation of gameplay systems, see my Roguelite Demo.

title: DSP-Demo — Procedural Acoustics & Occlusion Engine
subtitle: Unity / C# / FMOD Middleware
description:
A runtime room acoustics and source occlusion system built in Unity and FMOD. Instead of relying on static, pre-placed trigger volumes, the core flood-fill algorithm and 6-axis raycasting dynamically detect room geometry, total volume, and material hardness every frame. These physical parameters are calculated in real-time and mapped directly into FMOD DSP parameters—specifically driving Reverb Time, Early/Late Delay, Diffusion, High Cut, and Low Gain. 

Development Note: All audio design, DSP calculations, and acoustic logic in this project were developed entirely by me. Surrounding gameplay elements (player movement, combat triggers) were AI-assisted to quickly build an interactive testbed for the audio systems — the focus here is the sound architecture. For a from-scratch implementation of gameplay systems, see my Roguelite Demo.
